entries.rule: retrodiction: for engagement and efficacy a model first public after a patient result on the same target (member or not) is a retrodiction; a retrodiction that reproduced the human data is retro, never same

entries.adjudication_note: Retrodiction rule: engagement model first public 2010, after sorafenib (same target and action) lowered Ktrans in RCC patients (Hahn 2008); it reproduced the human perfusion drop, so retro, never same.

entries.note: Label 206947s003 (Revised 05/2016) sec 12.1 re-read: combination beat each drug alone in RCC xenografts. Retro 2016, lenvatinib, oral, everolimus, stage_or_line hold. Study 205 combo did not beat lenvatinib alone (HR 0.66, p=0.12): note overstates; partial.
Du 2022 (epub 2022-02-09) quote verbatim; catequentinib = anlotinib, oral; Zhou 2019 (epub 2019-03-22) first-line RCC PFS primary predates it, so retro, 2022, stage_or_line hold.

NCT00664326 results (posted 2012-11-28) list serious 'Hepatic function abnormal' 1/49; PharmR bundle shows rat/dog liver findings with enzyme elevations. RCC patients replace the CRC import correctly; same/partial, regorafenib, oral, stage_or_line, 2012 hold.
Motzer 2015 (epub 2015-10-22) proteinuria sentence verbatim; PharmR bundle line 605 'renal toxicity in rats and monkeys, including proteinuria'. Lenvatinib, oral, stage_or_line, same 2015 hold.
Yamamoto 2014 (epub 2014-09-06) conclusion verbatim; lenvatinib, oral, unselected opener at 2014 for a patient-level vascular-score prediction holds.

entries.rule: same/contra from a pairing whose trial source attributes the result to conditions the model never tested -> untested; rule 5 not_measured
entries.note: CLEAR biomarker (epub 2024-12-11) quote verbatim; lenvatinib, oral, pembrolizumab, stage_or_line right. The model's IHC vascular score for lenvatinib alone was never measured (RNA signature, combination arm, not the primary endpoint); entry already carries untested_reason not_measured.
entries.adjudication_note: Efficacy rule plus rule 5 not_measured: combination exception covers only a primary endpoint; this is a non-primary RNA-signature analysis on lenvatinib+pembrolizumab, so the model's IHC vascular score was never tested.

entries.note: Eisen 2012 grade 3 sentence verbatim; abstract also gives 35% drug-related SAEs, two likely drug-related deaths, 'requires close monitoring'. Harms mice could show; contra, 2012, regorafenib, oral, stage_or_line hold.

Zhou 2019 'more favorable safety profile' verbatim; Du 2022 'without obvious toxicity' verbatim. Same drug's own earlier RCC result makes it retro, partial (28.9% grade 3-4); catequentinib, oral, stage_or_line hold.

missing: Yamamoto 2014 Vascular Cell (doi:10.1186/2045-824X-6-18, PMID 25197551): lenvatinib 19-model xenograft panel with a vascular-score (MVD + pericyte coverage) sensitivity biomarker; kidney cancer had the highest MVD/vascular score in human specimens. A patient-level prediction track for lenvatinib, likely untested (not_measured) in RCC; published after Study 205's ASCO 2014 readout.

FDA review of the lenvatinib RCC supplement (NDA 206947 S-007, 2016) and the 2016 label section 12/13 stating lenvatinib+everolimus exceeded either drug in RCC xenografts: not in the bundle; a regulator source that could date the lenvatinib RCC-xenograft retrodiction to 2016 rather than 2017.

Xie 2018 Cancer Sci (doi:10.1111/cas.13536): anlotinib preclinical characterization with in-vivo xenografts, published before the RCC phase II paper (2019); check whether a renal xenograft was included, which would give anlotinib a prospective model.

Famitinib RCC patient data: phase II NCT01829841 (started 2011-05, no results posted) and camrelizumab+famitinib RCC cohort (Qu 2021 Clin Cancer Res, doi:10.1158/1078-0432.ccr-21-1698). Only famitinib model found is gastric BGC-823 xenograft (doi:10.3892/ol.2016.4909), not RCC; draft's 'no famitinib RCC model' stands.
rule_questions: A retrodiction (efficacy 3, retro 2017) on a track whose prior prospective entry is same (2012): should the track's latest status become retro, hiding the prospective match, or should retro entries not change a track's displayed status once it has a prospective same?

Rule 6 says each cell opens at model_first_use_year with untested; the two safety tracks open directly at same with model_first_use_year 2008/2010. Is an opening untested entry required per track, and should lint enforce it?

Lenvatinib (Study 205) is listed as a patient_trial on the regorafenib 786-O track and lenvatinib's own xenografts share that model_id: is 'nude-mouse RCC cell-line xenograft' one system across sponsors and cell lines (786-O vs A-498/Caki), or one track per member drug?

Patient-level (biomarker) track paired with a combination arm and a different assay of the same biological variable (RNA MVD signature vs IHC vascular score): the rules do not say whether that is a different readout (untested/not_measured) or an admissible contra at low confidence.

Passing tolerability claims: saf 4 scores 'well-tolerated' vs 33% grade 3 HFSR as contra, saf 5 scores 'without obvious toxicity' vs 28.9% grade 3-4 as retro partial because the trial authors call the profile favourable. Should the bar be the patients' grade 3+ rate or the trial authors' verdict?
